entries.basis: Initial extraction21adebd and current InstructorClassCard have the same seven prop names: four lifecycle statuses, one labeled action destination, count/site/course content and host-formatted activity. There was no card menu, persistence callback, date parser or external icon/image input to restore. The owned Link adapter handles routing callbacks; fixed decorative icons/avatar preserve fallback behavior. Documented clause ownership resolves the prior attribution successor without requiring an invented approval for unchanged API scope. F/T/V lineage,21case unit coverage, batch66 native status/focus/host-date/fallback/one-route checks and HB12 reviewed long-text/theme/density presentation remain accepted; the later literal-label fix is integrated and covered.

entries.basis: Initial extraction21adebd and current LearnerClassCard have the same nine prop names: course/instructor content, progress, next activity, due/reference inputs, Details/Continue destinations and onContinue. Status refers to the existing progress/due presentation; no lifecycle-status API existed in either source. Current named/clamped progress, translated due/date fallbacks, isolated native links, exact callback delivery, meaningful headings and noninteractive decorative regions retain F/T/V, corrected all-engine learner-card native and HB12 reviewed presentation evidence. Source-backed ownership documentation resolves the ambiguous status successor without adding unsupported props.
